questions.prompt: GTA 6 is out and the cheat codes are already everywhere — the whole city is an open toy box tonight, every secret on the table at once. Which scene sounds most like yours tonight?

options.text: Buzzing — scrolling the cheat list, my brain already three heists ahead.
Cheats on, straight in — tonight I'm bending the city to see what it can do.
Playing it straight first — I'll learn the city before I start breaking its rules.
Letting the rush pass — everyone else can chase the secrets, I'll stroll in when it's quiet.

questions.prompt: Taylor Swift threw it back at the CMAs with 'Our Song' — a song from 2006, back on the stage she left thirteen years ago. When a song from another era of your life comes home like that, where are you tonight?

options.text: Singing every word — a song from 2006 coming home pulls me right back.
Soaking in the nostalgia — slow and easy, letting the throwback wash over me.
Appreciating the craft — thirteen years away, and she walked back on that stage like she never left.
That era's behind me — a sweet song, but I've moved on from it.

questions.prompt: Best Buy's Black Friday sale is live — the deals are out there tonight, the clock's ticking, and everyone's either hunting or holding back. The deal you want is right there. Tonight, which way are you leaning?

options.text: Grabbing it now — the good stuff goes fast and I'm not missing it.
Waiting it out — I'll compare, sleep on it, and buy when I'm sure.
Stuck scrolling — too many deals, too many tabs, and I can't pick one.
Skipping it entirely — the couch wins tonight, the sale can wait.

questions.prompt: The new Cliff Booth film just landed and the reviews are in — it's a movie-night kind of evening, the kind where the lights go down and the couch is the best seat. If someone handled tonight's movie-night spread for you, what would you want in front of you?

options.text: The full spread — loaded nachos, popcorn, the works, no shortcuts.
A warm mug to cradle — cocoa or tea, slow sips through the film.
A shareable board — something for everyone to pick at.
Just water, I don't need anything else tonight.

questions.prompt: GTA VI is finally out — Vice City is open tonight, and the city's got its own soundtrack waiting: the radio, the streets, the hum of a world years in the making. What does stepping into it sound like to you tonight?

options.text: The radio up loud — a new city's soundtrack is half the point of going in.
The city hum, easy — windows down, driving slow, letting Vice City wash over me.
My own lofi underneath — the new world can wait, I'm keeping tonight calm.
Quiet — launch night is loud enough out there, I want stillness in here.

questions.prompt: The next James Bond has been revealed — a new era just started, and suddenly the evening has a new daydream in it. In the hour ahead, what does your evening feel like?

options.text: Debating the pick with friends — everyone has a take on the new Bond.
A slow daydream — picturing the new era, the car, the theme, the whole thing.
A quiet wind-down — the reveal can wait, one cozy thing done properly.
A full stop — the day is done, I'm switching off entirely.
